-- base_mu / base_sd are generator internals: excluded to prevent target leakage.
select
    sensor_id,
    site_id,
    asset_id,
    metric,
    unit as unit_nominal
from read_csv('data/bronze/operational/sensors.csv', header = true, auto_detect = true)

select
    asset_id,
    site_id,
    asset_type,
    health_state,
    cast(commissioned_year as integer) as commissioned_year
from read_csv('data/bronze/operational/assets.csv', header = true, auto_detect = true)

select
    cast(booking_date as date)      as booking_date,
    site_id,
    unit_id,
    cast(is_occupied as boolean)    as is_occupied,
    cast(adr_inr as double)         as adr_inr,
    channel
from read_csv('data/bronze/operational/bookings.csv', header = true, auto_detect = true)

select
    vendor_id,
    strptime(month || '-01', '%Y-%m-%d')::date as month_start,
    cast(avg_response_h as double)             as avg_response_h,
    cast(avg_resolution_h as double)           as avg_resolution_h,
    cast(sla_breach_pct as double)             as sla_breach_pct,
    cast(invoices_inr as bigint)               as invoices_inr
from read_csv('data/bronze/vendor_sla/vendor_sla.csv', header = true, auto_detect = true)

select
    row_number() over (order by site_id) as site_key,
    site_id, site_name, city, asset_class, units, base_adr_inr
from "opstwin"."seeds"."sites"

select
    ticket_id,
    site_id,
    asset_id,
    category,
    priority,
    status,
    vendor_id,
    cast(opened_at_utc as timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC' as opened_at_utc,
    cast(closed_at_utc as timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC' as closed_at_utc,
    cast(cost_inr as double)                              as cost_inr
from read_csv('data/bronze/operational/work_orders.csv', header = true, auto_detect = true)

select
    row_number() over (order by vendor_id) as vendor_key,
    vendor_id, vendor_name, service_tier
from "opstwin"."seeds"."vendors"

select site_id
from "opstwin"."gold"."dim_site"
where site_id is null

select site_key
from "opstwin"."gold"."dim_site"
where site_key is null

select
    site_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "opstwin"."gold"."dim_site"
where site_id is not null
group by site_id
having count(*) > 1

select
    site_key as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "opstwin"."gold"."dim_site"
where site_key is not null
group by site_key
having count(*) > 1

select
    booking_date,
    site_id,
    unit_id,
    is_occupied,
    adr_inr,
    channel,
    case when is_occupied then adr_inr else 0 end as revenue_inr
from "opstwin"."staging"."stg_bookings"

with all_values as (

    select
        priority as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "opstwin"."staging"."stg_work_orders"
    group by priority

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'P1','P2','P3'
)

select vendor_key
from "opstwin"."gold"."dim_vendor"
where vendor_key is null

select ticket_id
from "opstwin"."staging"."stg_work_orders"
where ticket_id is null

select
    vendor_key as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "opstwin"."gold"."dim_vendor"
where vendor_key is not null
group by vendor_key
having count(*) > 1

select
    ticket_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "opstwin"."staging"."stg_work_orders"
where ticket_id is not null
group by ticket_id
having count(*) > 1

select
    row_number() over (order by a.asset_id) as asset_key,
    a.asset_id, s.site_key, a.asset_type, a.commissioned_year
from "opstwin"."staging"."stg_assets" a
join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_site" s on s.site_id = a.site_id

select
    row_number() over (order by a.asset_id) as asset_key,
    a.asset_id, s.site_key, a.asset_type, a.commissioned_year
from "opstwin"."staging"."stg_assets" a
join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_site" s on s.site_id = a.site_id

-- Grain: one unit per day.
select
    cast(strftime(b.booking_date, '%Y%m%d') as integer) as date_key,
    s.site_key, b.unit_id, b.is_occupied, b.adr_inr, b.revenue_inr, b.channel
from "opstwin"."silver"."silver_bookings" b
join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_site" s on s.site_id = b.site_id

-- Grain: one vendor per calendar month.
select
    cast(strftime(m.month_start, '%Y%m%d') as integer) as date_key,
    v.vendor_key, m.month_start,
    m.avg_response_h, m.avg_resolution_h, m.sla_breach_pct, m.invoices_inr
from "opstwin"."staging"."stg_vendors_sla" m
join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_vendor" v on v.vendor_id = m.vendor_id

select asset_key
from "opstwin"."gold"."dim_asset"
where asset_key is null

with child as (
    select site_key as from_field
    from "opstwin"."gold"."dim_asset"
    where site_key is not null
),

parent as (
    select site_key as to_field
    from "opstwin"."gold"."dim_site"
)

select
    from_field

from child
left join parent
    on child.from_field = parent.to_field

where parent.to_field is null

select
    asset_key as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "opstwin"."gold"."dim_asset"
where asset_key is not null
group by asset_key

with src as (
    select *
    from read_csv(
        'data/bronze/telemetry/site=*/month=*/part.csv',
        header = true,
        auto_detect = true,
        hive_partitioning = true,
        union_by_name = true
    )
)
select
    cast(ts_utc as timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC'           as ts_utc,
    cast(ingested_at_utc as timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC'  as ingested_at_utc,
    site_id,
    sensor_id,
    asset_id,
    metric,
    cast(value as double)                                    as value_raw,
    unit                                                     as unit_raw,
    cast(battery_pct as double)                              as battery_pct,
    firmware,
    month                                                    as partition_month
from src

select vendor_key
from "opstwin"."gold"."fact_vendor_sla_monthly"
where vendor_key is null

with wo as (select * from "opstwin"."staging"."stg_work_orders"),
targets as (select * from "opstwin"."seeds"."sla_targets")
select
    wo.ticket_id,
    wo.site_id,
    wo.asset_id,
    wo.vendor_id,
    wo.category,
    wo.priority,
    wo.status,
    wo.opened_at_utc,
    wo.closed_at_utc,
    wo.cost_inr,
    t.target_resolution_hours,
    case when wo.closed_at_utc is not null
         then date_diff('minute', wo.opened_at_utc, wo.closed_at_utc) / 60.0
    end                                                        as resolution_hours,
    (wo.status = 'OPEN')                                       as is_open,
    case when wo.closed_at_utc is not null
         then date_diff('minute', wo.opened_at_utc, wo.closed_at_utc) / 60.0
              > t.target_resolution_hours
         else false
    end                                                        as is_sla_breach
from wo
left join targets t on t.priority = wo.priority

select
    row_number() over (order by se.sensor_id) as sensor_key,
    se.sensor_id, a.asset_key, s.site_key, se.metric, se.unit_nominal
from "opstwin"."staging"."stg_sensors" se
join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_asset" a on a.asset_id = se.asset_id
join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_site"  s on s.site_id  = se.site_id

with all_values as (

        status as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "opstwin"."silver"."silver_work_orders"
    group by status

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (

)

select ticket_id
from "opstwin"."silver"."silver_work_orders"
where ticket_id is null

select
    ticket_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "opstwin"."silver"."silver_work_orders"
where ticket_id is not null
group by ticket_id
having count(*) > 1

select sensor_key
from "opstwin"."gold"."dim_sensor"
where sensor_key is null

select
    sensor_key as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "opstwin"."gold"."dim_sensor"
where sensor_key is not null
group by sensor_key
having count(*) > 1

-- Grain: one maintenance ticket.
select
    w.ticket_id,
    cast(strftime(w.opened_at_utc::date, '%Y%m%d') as integer) as opened_date_key,
    s.site_key, a.asset_key, v.vendor_key,
    w.category, w.priority, w.status,
    w.opened_at_utc, w.closed_at_utc,
    w.resolution_hours, w.target_resolution_hours,
    w.is_sla_breach, w.is_open, w.cost_inr
from "opstwin"."silver"."silver_work_orders" w
join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_site"   s on s.site_id   = w.site_id
join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_asset"  a on a.asset_id  = w.asset_id
join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_vendor" v on v.vendor_id = w.vendor_id

select ticket_id
from "opstwin"."gold"."fact_work_orders"
where ticket_id is null

with child as (
    select vendor_key as from_field
    from "opstwin"."gold"."fact_work_orders"
    where vendor_key is not null
),

parent as (
    select vendor_key as to_field
    from "opstwin"."gold"."dim_vendor"
)

select
    from_field

from child
left join parent
    on child.from_field = parent.to_field

where parent.to_field is null

select
    ticket_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "opstwin"."gold"."fact_work_orders"
where ticket_id is not null
group by ticket_id
having count(*) > 1

with w as (
    select vendor_key,
           count(*)                                      as tickets,
           avg(resolution_hours)                         as avg_resolution_hours,
           sum(case when is_sla_breach then 1 else 0 end) as breaches,
           sum(cost_inr)                                 as spend_inr
    from "opstwin"."gold"."fact_work_orders" group by 1
),
m as (
    select vendor_key, avg(sla_breach_pct) as reported_breach_pct, sum(invoices_inr) as invoiced_inr
    from "opstwin"."gold"."fact_vendor_sla_monthly" group by 1
)
select
    v.vendor_id, v.vendor_name, v.service_tier,
    w.tickets,
    round(w.avg_resolution_hours, 2)                   as avg_resolution_hours,
    w.breaches,
    round(100.0 * w.breaches / nullif(w.tickets, 0), 2) as breach_pct,
    round(m.reported_breach_pct, 2)                     as reported_breach_pct,
    w.spend_inr, m.invoiced_inr
from w
join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_vendor" v on v.vendor_key = w.vendor_key
left join m on m.vendor_key = w.vendor_key

select sensor_id
from "opstwin"."staging"."stg_telemetry"
where sensor_id is null

with all_values as (

    select
        metric as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "opstwin"."staging"."stg_telemetry"
    group by metric

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'temperature','humidity','power','water','vibration'
)

select ts_utc
from "opstwin"."staging"."stg_telemetry"
where ts_utc is null

with deduped as (
    select *
    from "opstwin"."staging"."stg_telemetry"
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by sensor_id, ts_utc
        order by ingested_at_utc asc
    ) = 1
)
select
    sensor_id || '|' || strftime(ts_utc, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S') as reading_id,
    ts_utc,
    ingested_at_utc,
    site_id,
    sensor_id,
    asset_id,
    metric,
    case
        when metric = 'temperature' and unit_raw = 'F' then (value_raw - 32.0) * 5.0 / 9.0
        else value_raw
    end                                                     as value_normalized,
    case
        when metric = 'temperature' then 'C'
        else unit_raw
    end                                                     as unit_normalized,
    value_raw,
    unit_raw,
    battery_pct,
    firmware,
    partition_month,
    (ingested_at_utc > ts_utc)                              as is_late_arrival,
    date_diff('hour', ts_utc, ingested_at_utc)              as hours_late
from deduped

with clean as (
    select sensor_id, value_normalized
    from "opstwin"."silver"."int_telemetry_clean"
    where value_normalized is not null
),
med as (
    select sensor_id, median(value_normalized) as med_value
    from clean group by sensor_id
)
select
    c.sensor_id,
    m.med_value,
    median(abs(c.value_normalized - m.med_value)) as mad_value,
    count(*)                                      as n_obs
from clean c
join med m on m.sensor_id = c.sensor_id
group by c.sensor_id, m.med_value

select
    reading_id,
    ts_utc,
    site_id,
    sensor_id,
    asset_id,
    metric,
    unit_raw,
    'NULL_VALUE'::varchar as quarantine_reason,
    current_timestamp     as quarantined_at_utc
from "opstwin"."silver"."int_telemetry_clean"
where value_normalized is null

with all_values as (

    select
        quarantine_reason as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "opstwin"."silver"."silver_telemetry_quarantine"
    group by quarantine_reason

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'NULL_VALUE'
)

select
    c.reading_id,
    c.ts_utc,
    c.ingested_at_utc,
    c.site_id,
    c.sensor_id,
    c.asset_id,
    c.metric,
    c.value_normalized,
    c.unit_normalized,
    c.battery_pct,
    c.firmware,
    c.partition_month,
    c.is_late_arrival,
    c.hours_late,
    (abs(c.value_normalized - s.med_value)
        > greatest(4 * s.mad_value, 0.30 * s.med_value))    as is_outlier
from "opstwin"."silver"."int_telemetry_clean" c
join "opstwin"."silver"."int_sensor_stats" s on s.sensor_id = c.sensor_id
where c.value_normalized is not null

with all_values as (

    select
        unit_normalized as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "opstwin"."silver"."silver_telemetry"
    group by unit_normalized

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'C','%','kW','L/min','mm/s'
)

select reading_id
from "opstwin"."silver"."silver_telemetry"
where reading_id is null

select value_normalized
from "opstwin"."silver"."silver_telemetry"
where value_normalized is null

select
    reading_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "opstwin"."silver"."silver_telemetry"
where reading_id is not null
group by reading_id
having count(*) > 1

with bounds as (
    select min(ts_utc)::date as d_min, max(ts_utc)::date as d_max
    from "opstwin"."silver"."silver_telemetry"
),
days as (
    select unnest(generate_series(d_min, d_max, interval 1 day))::date as date_day
    from bounds
)
select
    cast(strftime(date_day, '%Y%m%d') as integer) as date_key,
    date_day,
    year(date_day)      as year,
    quarter(date_day)   as quarter,
    month(date_day)     as month,
    day(date_day)       as day_of_month,
    dayofweek(date_day) as day_of_week,
    dayofweek(date_day) in (0, 6) as is_weekend,
    date_trunc('month', date_day)::date as month_start
from days

select date_key
from "opstwin"."gold"."dim_date"
where date_key is null

with child as (
    select date_key as from_field
    from "opstwin"."gold"."fact_bookings"
    where date_key is not null
),

parent as (

    from "opstwin"."gold"."dim_date"
)

from child

select

from "opstwin"."gold"."dim_date"
where date_key is not null
group by date_key
having count(*) > 1

-- Grain: one sensor reading per hour.
select
    t.reading_id,
    cast(strftime(t.ts_utc::date, '%Y%m%d') as integer) as date_key,
    s.site_key, a.asset_key, se.sensor_key,
    t.ts_utc, t.metric, t.value_normalized, t.unit_normalized,
    t.battery_pct, t.firmware, t.is_late_arrival, t.hours_late, t.is_outlier
from "opstwin"."silver"."silver_telemetry" t
join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_site"   s  on s.site_id    = t.site_id
join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_asset"  a  on a.asset_id   = t.asset_id
join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_sensor" se on se.sensor_id = t.sensor_id

select reading_id
from "opstwin"."gold"."fact_telemetry"
where reading_id is null

-- Star joins must not drop or duplicate any silver reading.
with s as (select count(*) as n from "opstwin"."silver"."silver_telemetry"),
     f as (select count(*) as n from "opstwin"."gold"."fact_telemetry")
select s.n as silver_rows, f.n as fact_rows from s, f where s.n <> f.n

with child as (
    select asset_key as from_field
    from "opstwin"."gold"."fact_telemetry"
    where asset_key is not null

parent as (

    from "opstwin"."gold"."dim_asset"
)

select

from child

with child as (

    where sensor_key is not null
),

parent as (

    from "opstwin"."gold"."dim_sensor"
)

select

where parent.to_field is null

with child as (
    select site_key as from_field
    from "opstwin"."gold"."fact_telemetry"
    where site_key is not null
),

parent as (

select

select

from "opstwin"."gold"."fact_telemetry"
where reading_id is not null
group by reading_id
having count(*) > 1

-- Energy: hourly mean kW summed = kWh. Water: hourly mean L/min x 60 = litres.
with b as (
    select date_key, site_key,
           count(*)                                     as unit_days,
           sum(case when is_occupied then 1 else 0 end) as occupied_units,
           sum(revenue_inr)                             as revenue_inr
    from "opstwin"."gold"."fact_bookings" group by 1, 2
),
t as (
    select date_key, site_key,
           sum(case when metric = 'power' then value_normalized else 0 end)      as energy_kwh,
           sum(case when metric = 'water' then value_normalized * 60 else 0 end) as water_litres,
           avg(case when metric = 'temperature' then value_normalized end)       as avg_temp_c,
           sum(case when is_outlier then 1 else 0 end)                           as outlier_readings
    from "opstwin"."gold"."fact_telemetry" group by 1, 2
),
w as (
    select opened_date_key as date_key, site_key, count(*) as tickets_opened
    from "opstwin"."gold"."fact_work_orders" group by 1, 2
)
select
    d.date_day, s.site_id, s.site_name,
    b.unit_days, b.occupied_units,
    round(100.0 * b.occupied_units / nullif(b.unit_days, 0), 2) as occupancy_pct,
    b.revenue_inr,
    round(t.energy_kwh, 2)       as energy_kwh,
    round(t.water_litres, 2)     as water_litres,
    round(t.avg_temp_c, 2)       as avg_temp_c,
    t.outlier_readings,
    coalesce(w.tickets_opened, 0) as tickets_opened
from b
join t on t.date_key = b.date_key and t.site_key = b.site_key
join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_date" d on d.date_key = b.date_key
join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_site" s on s.site_key = b.site_key
left join w on w.date_key = b.date_key and w.site_key = b.site_key

with t as (
    select a.asset_key, d.month_start,
           avg(case when f.metric = 'vibration' then f.value_normalized end) as avg_vibration,
           max(case when f.metric = 'vibration' then f.value_normalized end) as max_vibration,
           avg(case when f.metric = 'power'     then f.value_normalized end) as avg_power_kw,
           sum(case when f.is_outlier then 1 else 0 end)                     as outlier_readings
    from "opstwin"."gold"."fact_telemetry" f
    join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_asset" a on a.asset_key = f.asset_key
    join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_date"  d on d.date_key  = f.date_key
    group by 1, 2
),
w as (
    select asset_key, date_trunc('month', opened_at_utc)::date as month_start,
           count(*) as tickets, avg(resolution_hours) as mttr_hours, sum(cost_inr) as maintenance_cost_inr
    from "opstwin"."gold"."fact_work_orders" group by 1, 2
)
select
    a.asset_id, a.asset_type, s.site_id, t.month_start,
    round(t.avg_vibration, 3) as avg_vibration,
    round(t.max_vibration, 3) as max_vibration,
    round(t.avg_power_kw, 3)  as avg_power_kw,
    t.outlier_readings,
    coalesce(w.tickets, 0)    as tickets,
    round(w.mttr_hours, 2)    as mttr_hours,
    w.maintenance_cost_inr
from t
join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_asset" a on a.asset_key = t.asset_key
join "opstwin"."gold"."dim_site"  s on s.site_key  = a.site_key
left join w on w.asset_key = t.asset_key and w.month_start = t.month_start

-- Fails if any bronze row is unaccounted for after dedup, quarantine, and silver load.
with b as (select count(*) as n from "opstwin"."staging"."stg_telemetry"),
     c as (select count(*) as n from "opstwin"."silver"."int_telemetry_clean"),
     s as (select count(*) as n from "opstwin"."silver"."silver_telemetry"),
     q as (select count(*) as n from "opstwin"."silver"."silver_telemetry_quarantine")
select b.n as bronze_rows, c.n as deduped_rows, s.n as silver_rows, q.n as quarantine_rows
from b, c, s, q
where c.n <> s.n + q.n
   or b.n <= c.n
